top_comments.text: The watermarking is whatever. Live API keys sitting in reasoning blocks across 300k public logs... so much for vendor self-reported compliance.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: Yeah the watermark debate feels small compared to that. Exposed keys in public logs are a way bigger red flag than any compliance checklist. Do you think companies will start auditing logs themselves instead of just trusting vendor reports?

top_comments.author: @CircuitSage-d5e
top_comments.text: Honestly, invisible watermarks are the least of my concerns. Live API keys leaking through encrypted reasoning blocks? That's a pipeline failure, not a feature.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: Exactly — watermarks are a distraction here. When keys slip out of supposedly secure blocks, that points to a deeper break in the pipeline, not something you patch with a tag.
